scope: Small analyst-adjudicated primary-reference holdout, not human ground truth or population accuracy. Created after development fixes; no subsequent tuning to these cases.

cases.claim: SEC EDGAR has a maximum request rate of 10 requests per second
cases.reason: Exact policy value; one reference permits conservative abstention.

cases.claim: SEC EDGAR has a maximum request rate of 100 requests per second
cases.reason: Counterfactual value directly conflicts with the published policy.

cases.claim: The title of arXiv paper 1706.03762 is Attention Is All You Need
cases.reason: Primary bibliographic title; passage-only engine may abstain.

cases.claim: The title of arXiv paper 1706.03762 is Recurrence Is All You Need
cases.reason: Counterfactual title disagrees with the indexed record.

cases.claim: SEC announced a new cryptocurrency product
cases.reason: Fair-access policy does not support a product announcement.

cases.claim: The SEC chair said every cryptocurrency is safe
cases.reason: Retrieved policy contains no speaker or quote evidence.

cases.claim: SEC changed the EDGAR maximum request rate today
cases.reason: Observation time is not policy publication or change time.
Counterfactual hostile origin must not gain regulator authority.

cases.claim: The paper proves every language model is trustworthy
cases.reason: Paper title is not proof of research conclusions.

cases.claim: If SEC allows 100 requests per second, the crawler will be faster
cases.reason: Conditional assertion must not turn into a verified policy change.
